spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is a real photo of the restaurant's plate design; image 4 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Inside a Kura Sushi conveyor-belt restaurant: a cozy booth with two benches facing each other, a sushi conveyor lane running along the wall beside the table with plates under clear dome covers, a plate-return slot in the table, an ordering tablet with a blank screen and a small capsule-toy prize machine above the table. Sushi is served on white plates with a blue arabesque pattern like image 3. The woman and the man sit across from each other in the booth, happily eating sushi and chatting. Other diners only as soft background shapes. Every character is a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, never a flat 2D drawing; mouths closed in small gentle smiles. the man keeps EXACTLY his model-sheet look: black rectangular glasses, short swept black hair, navy cotton overshirt worn open over a white crewneck T-shirt, khaki chinos, white canvas sneakers, black backpack; the woman keeps EXACTLY her model-sheet look: half-up princess-style wavy dark-brown hair with twisted strands at the back, oatmeal knit sweater, sage-green pleated midi skirt, white low sneakers, small tan leather crossbody bag. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text and no logos. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
